title: Strict Public Price & PII Masking Enforcement (Rule 9)
description: Public listing serialization strictly excludes numeric asking prices, owner contact details, and client budgets in compliance with project policy.

title: Uncaught 503 EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE in auth route tests
description: Registration route test failed with HTTP 503 because the mock accountLifecycle service was missing from createApp dependencies.

title: Duplicate object key 'title' in localization messages
description: Key 'title' was declared twice within the admin object (section title vs table column header), overwriting section header text.

title: Docker container zombie process on termination (Missing init system)
description: Next.js dev/prod processes under sh -c ran as PID 1 without an init reaper, causing Docker daemon zombie process kill failures on shutdown.

title: Missing WEB_REVALIDATION_URL & DATABASE_URL Fallbacks
description: API initialization threw if WEB_REVALIDATION_URL was omitted or if only DIRECT_URL was defined in .env. Added sensible default and fallback.
